cultural.vision_reason: This is a documentary photograph of a group standing before a thatched building, showing traditional dress (loincloth, waist ornaments) and body scarification, consistent with an ethnographic record of daily/traditional life in Nigeria attributed to the Anga people.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, frontal half-length portrait of small group of female adults, male adult and child standing in front of building. Male wearing loin-cloth, females wearing belts or waist-ornaments with bunches of leave or grass at front. Some scarification on face and torso. Male has large swellings on neck. Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
